DML.SELECT: SELECT incident_report_log_id as "incidentReportLogId", log_type_id as "logTypeId", log_type_param_id as "logTypeParamId", value as "value", enabled as "enabled", visible as "visible" FROM rt.ims_incident_report_log_values WHERE enabled = true or enabled is null
DML.INSERT: INSERT INTO rt.ims_incident_report_log_values (incident_report_log_id, log_type_id, log_type_param_id, value, enabled, visible, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (:incidentReportLogId, :logTypeId, :logTypeParamId, :value, :enabled, :visible, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
DML.UPDATE: UPDATE rt.ims_incident_report_log_values SET value = :value, enabled = :enabled, visible = :visible, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE incident_report_log_id = :incidentReportLogId AND log_type_id = :logTypeId AND log_type_param_id = :logTypeParamId
DML.DELETE: DELETE FROM rt.ims_incident_report_log_values WHERE incident_report_log_id = :incidentReportLogId AND log_type_id = :logTypeId AND log_type_param_id = :logTypeParamId
